labels.rationale: Manually audited at the pin: libraryPaths is projected at line 90 as length > 0, but hasConfiguredLibrary enters the callback body at 698 and 703 and its dependency array at 731. Array length and callback lifetime/snapshot analysis are outside the strict scalar-equality subset. This is research, not a safe migration claim.

Manually audited selectors at lines 67 and 85 already return booleans for playing and selected state. They are negative controls for a new projection recommendation; their helper/property/optional branches are not evidence for widening the supported expression subset.
